title: Once Done
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：once　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 once 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Once, in 1991 the musician visited the score at the piano, and everybody in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the musician had ② once visited the score, and nobody had asked a single question. The musician had come to the hall two nights earlier, and spoke little of the hall he had left behind him.

The programme for December 1985 puts it plainer. The score was ③ once famous, and the listener who kept it had ④ once played it twice before the winter came; nothing in the hall was ever done once in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else. He visited the score ⑤ once in silence, and nobody in the hall doubted it; of all who visited it that night, he visited it ⑥ once in public. He was not a man who explained himself, and the hall had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was that the score be played ⑦ once every night, and that whoever did it be ⑧ once careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done once.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001 she visited the score ⑨ once in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Once, she said in 2003, that was the part the hall never forgot; the programme still speaks once of it. She kept the score in the same piano for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the hall never forgot how once it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 曾经（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had once visited …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 曾经（修饰形容词：once famous）
C. adv. 一次（评注性状语，置于句首：Once, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 一次（修饰过去分词：had once played it）
E. adv. 曾经（句末状语：… once in silence）
F. adv. 曾经（句末状语：… once in public，第 6 处）
G. adv. 一次（被动结构中的中位状语：be played once）
H. adv. 一次（修饰形容词：be once careful about the whole business）

answers.why: once 意为“曾经”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Once, in 1991 …。
once 意为“曾经”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had once visited the score。
once 意为“曾经”，此处修饰形容词 famous（有名）：was once famous。
once 意为“一次”，此处修饰过去分词 played：had once played it twice。
once 意为“曾经”，此处置于句末修饰动词：visited the score once in silence。
once 意为“曾经”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夜晚, he did it once in public。
once 意为“一次”，被动结构 be played once 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
once 意为“一次”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be once careful about the whole business。
once 意为“曾经”，2001 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次拜访那件薄薄的乐谱，副词置于动词之后。
once 意为“一次”，母亲 2003 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Once, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，乐师一次在琴凳拜访那件薄薄的乐谱；音乐厅里人人都说那是头一回。（Once, …）
雨季到来之前，乐师已经曾经拜访那件薄薄的乐谱。（had once visited …）
那件薄薄的乐谱当时曾经有名。（once famous）
保管它的那位听客在入冬前已经一次把它弹过两回。（had once played it）
叔叔曾经拜访那件薄薄的乐谱，音乐厅里没有一个人怀疑。（… once …）
在那个夜晚里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最曾经。（the most once of all of them）
answers: Once, in 1991 the musician visited the score at the piano.
Before the December rains the musician had once visited the score.
The listener who kept it had once played it twice before the winter came.
He visited the score once in silence, and nobody in the hall doubted it.
Of all who did it that night, he did it once in public.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 once 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Once, in 1991 the musician visited the score, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the musician had once visited the score.
The score was once famous, or so the programme says.
The listener had once played it twice before the winter came.
My mother visited the score once in public when nobody else would.
Once, the hall never forgot that part of the story.
